ROBOTIS signs deal for roughly 750,000 MicroDuck actuators

The Pollen Robotics agreement covers XL330 joint actuators, with additional manufacturing capacity planned in Uzbekistan.

ChosunBiz ↗26 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2

A component supply agreement

ROBOTIS and Pollen Robotics signed on October 26 for approximately 750,000 XL330 actuators for MicroDuck. Each robot uses 15 actuators, and Pollen reports current demand for 50,000 robots. Contracted components should not be confused with completed robot deliveries.

Manufacturing capacity matters

ROBOTIS reportedly runs its Magok facility at full capacity of about 500,000 actuators annually. The contract therefore represents 1.5 times that annual capacity. A plant under construction in Uzbekistan is planned for completion this year and operation next year.

Forecasts versus contracted volume

ROBOTIS expects contract revenue from 2027. Pollen separately forecasts demand for at least one million actuators next year, beyond the roughly 750,000 contracted units. The story highlights small-joint supply constraints, while contract value and individual shipment schedules remain undisclosed.
